description: North Carolina Climate Trends Plotter is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by publisher not stated on the toolkit page. This map product that allows users to plot maps of trends in temperature and precipitation over selected time periods across North Carolina and other states in the Southeast. The tool shows positive and negative trends for individual monitoring stations over time and indicates whether or not the trend is statistically significant. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
